subject: general
question: In 2024, the Union Cabinet approved the continuation of three umbrella schemes merged into a unified central sector scheme under the Department of Science and Technology (DST). What is the name of this unified scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vigyan Dhara**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• In 2024, the Union Cabinet approved the continuation of three umbrella schemes merged into a unified central sector scheme under the Department of Science and Technology (DST) called **Vigyan Dhara**.
 
• The unified scheme aims to streamline and enhance the effectiveness of various science and technology initiatives by integrating them under a single framework.
 
• Vigyan Dhara focuses on promoting scientific research, fostering innovation, and providing comprehensive support to scientific institution
